entry.title: KEXP: Deep Sea Diver - Full Performance (Live on KEXP)

Deep Sea Diver Live on KEXP
On May 19, 2025, Deep Sea Diver hit the KEXP gathering space with a high-energy set featuring fan favorites like “Billboard Heart,” “Emergency,” and “Tiny Threads,” capped off by an intimate interview. The full performance was expertly captured by a team of six camera operators and brought to life by audio engineer Julian Martlew and mastering guru Matt Ogaz.
